name: numrush-monorepo
description: NumRush - Competitive Real-Time Multiplayer Number Hunt

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev:server'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev:client'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.android:sync: cd client && npm run build && npx cap sync android

author: NumRush Team
